title: Phf12 converges with Gatad1 while KDM5, SIN3A, and GATAD2B do not
exact_observed_result: In informative Gatad1-responsive glutamatergic populations, Phf12 converged with the Gatad1 signature, while Kdm5b, Kdm5c, Sin3a, and Gatad2b were near-zero or divergent; Gatad1 also induced Phf12 and nominally Kdm5a. / Phf12 induced a strong mixed Ptcd3/Chpf2/Atp6v0b/Stx16/Sf3b2/Stk16 module and repressed Gls, Grin2c, Snap25, and Tubb3, while Kmt2e and Gatad1 also produced narrow 151/155 responses with recurrent Atp6v0b, Chpf2, Ptcd3, Sfswap, Vps50, Snhg11, or Eno2 induction.
biological_interpretation: GATAD1 loss is tied to a selective PHF12-linked chromatin neighborhood rather than to generic KDM5, SIN3A, or NuRD subunit perturbation. / A subset of posterior glutamatergic neurons routes perturbations of PHF12/KMT2E/GATAD1 chromatin machinery into an organellar and RNA-processing response coupled to loss of synaptic transcripts.

support.evidence_summary: Gatad1:F003 reports Phf12 as the top Gatad1 neighbor in 151 and 155; Gatad1:F001 and Phf12:F001 resolve the overlapping Atp6v0b/Chpf2/Ptcd3/Gls module.

caveats: Gatad1 self-mRNA did not pass FDR.
The Kmt2e part of the merged story is sparser than the Gatad1-Phf12 relationship.

prior_expectation.summary: Gatad1:F003 reports Phf12 as the top Gatad1 neighbor in 151 and 155; Gatad1:F001 and Phf12:F001 resolve the overlapping Atp6v0b/Chpf2/Ptcd3/Gls module.
